narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to southeastern New Jersey on the afternoon of August 29. Rainfall totals were as high as 2.5 to 4.5 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding in Somers Point with several streets closed.
Multiple road closures in Ocean City due to flooding. Some vehicles were trapped in the flood waters.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLOOD REPORT FROM SOMERS POINT. ROAD FLOODING REPORTED. WATER DEEPER THAN 1 FOOT IN SOME AREAS. TIME ESTIMATED.
WATER UP TO 8 INCHES DEEP OVER THE ROAD AT THE INTERSECTION OF 34TH STREET AND BAY AVENUE. FIRST OBSERVED AT 1:30 PM. STILL FLOODED AT 3:15 PM.
MULTIPLE ROADS CLOSED AROUND 16TH STREET IN OCEAN CITY DUE TO HIGH WATER.
NUMEROUS ROADS FLOODED WEST OF ASBURY AVENUE IN OCEAN CITY. THE HAVEN AVENUE BASIN ROADS ARE ONLY PASSABLE BY HIGH WATER CLEARANCE MILITARY VEHICLES.
MANY ROADS AROUND HAVEN AVENUE ARE NOT PASSABLE. HIGH WATER RESCUES AND CARS SUBMERGED HAVE BEEN REPORTED.
